## Purpose
`/workflows/new/visual`: the visual workflow builder for a new workflow, optionally starting from a copy of an existing one.

## Responsibilities
- `VisualBuilderPage` reads `workflowsApi.get` when a copy source is given.
- `copyOf` renames it with `builderModel` helpers.
- It renders `WorkflowBuilder` in create mode.

Titled "Workflow builder — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`VisualBuilderPage`, `copyOf`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Workflow creation, through the builder.
